note: World Bank IDS, reporting low- and middle-income countries only. ext_debt_gni = total external debt stocks, % of GNI (DT.DOD.DECT.GN.ZS). china_share = PPG external debt owed to China (official bilateral) as % of all PPG external debt (DT.DOD.DPPG.CD); china_share_bilateral = same as % of bilateral PPG debt; bilateral_china_usd in billion USD. Chinese lending booked under private creditors is excluded, so China's role is understated for some countries.

china_share.label: Share of public external debt owed to China (bilateral)

china_share_bilateral.label: China's share of bilateral public debt

bilateral_china_usd.label: Public external debt owed to China (bilateral)
